description: This Java source file defines the ModuleUtil class, which provides utility methods for managing modules within the OpenMRS framework. It includes methods for starting up and shutting down modules, managing module files, comparing versions, expanding JAR files, loading resources, handling the application context refresh, and other module-related operations.

classes.name: ModuleUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing, manipulating, and interacting with modules in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes and starts the module system based on provided properties, loading specified modules or all modules from the modules directory.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stops all currently started modules and clears relevant static caches and data.

methods.name: insertModuleFile
methods.description: Adds an input stream as a module file in the module repository, ensuring no duplicate filenames.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions
methods.description: Checks if the current OpenMRS version matches any in a list of specified versions.

methods.name: isVersionInVersions
methods.description: Internal method to determine if a specific version string is within a list of versions.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions
methods.description: Determines whether a version matches a specified version range or pattern, supporting wildcards and bounds.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion
methods.description: Enforces that a version falls within a specified range, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: compareVersion
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine their ordering.

methods.name: compareVersionIgnoringQualifier
methods.description: Compares two version strings ignoring qualifiers like -SNAPSHOT.

methods.name: isVersionWithQualifier
methods.description: Checks whether a version string contains a qualifier suffix.

methods.name: getModuleRepository
methods.description: Returns the directory where modules are stored, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: file2url
methods.description: Converts a File object to a URL.

methods.name: expandJar
methods.description: Expands a jar file into a temporary directory, optionally filtering for specific entries.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands an InputStream to a file at a specified location.

methods.name: getURLStream
methods.description: Downloads contents from a URL as an InputStream, following redirects.

methods.name: openConnectionCheckRedirects
methods.description: Follows HTTP redirects up to five times when opening a URLConnection.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Downloads and returns contents of a URL as a String.

methods.name: checkForModuleUpdates
methods.description: Checks all loaded modules for available updates by retrieving and parsing their update URLs.

methods.name: allowAdmin
methods.description: Checks if uploading or admin actions are permitted based on runtime properties.

methods.name: refreshApplicationContext
methods.description: Refreshes the Spring application context, reinitializing modules and services.

methods.name: checkMandatoryModulesStarted
methods.description: Verifies all modules marked as mandatory are currently started; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IDs for modules marked as mandatory via global properties.

methods.name: getModuleForPath
methods.description: Determines which loaded module should handle a given resource path.

methods.name: getPathForResource
methods.description: Calculates the local resource path within a module for a given global path.

methods.name: getPackagesFromFile
methods.description: Extracts package names contained within a jar file.

methods.name: getResourceFromApi
methods.description: Retrieves a resource from the module's API jar file.

methods.name: getResourceFromInnerJar
methods.description: Loads a resource from a jar contained inside another jar.

methods.name: getDevelopmentDirectory
methods.description: Returns the development directory for a module if configured.
